Karnataka CM Shivakumar comments on Sita, criticizes opposition over KPSC row

Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar stated that Sita's character is greater than Rama's, advocating for women's leadership. Separately, addressing the Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC) row, Shivakumar accused the BJP-JD(S) alliance of being the 'Godfathers of all scams' and the 'NDA Pitamaha' of such irregularities. He asserted that the opposition parties are responsible for the KPSC irregularities.
